variants.headline: {{partner}}'s cultural pace changes
body: Reports from {{partnerLink}} show culture per turn changing from {{previousCulture}} at turn {{cultureFromTurn}} to {{culture}} at turn {{cultureToTurn}}.
Cultural output is one way to follow a neighbor's development. Keep this change in view alongside later diplomatic and cultural reports.

variants.headline: A cultural dispatch from {{partner}}
body: Recorded culture per turn in {{partnerLink}} is {{culture}}, compared with {{previousCulture}} in the earlier observation. Those observations date to turns {{cultureFromTurn}} and {{cultureToTurn}}.

variants.headline: A new policy direction
body: Our recorded policy adoptions and branch openings during this period include {{policies}}. The latest event is dated turn {{eventTurn}}.

variants.headline: Our ideology changes
body: A recorded switch from {{previousIdeology}} to {{ideology}} took place at turn {{eventTurn}}.

variants.headline: Tourism output {{direction}} in {{partner}}

variants.headline: New wonders recorded in {{city}}
body: Comparable observations of {{cityLink}} under the same owner show these new wonders: {{wonders}}. They were absent at turn {{fromTurn}} and present at turn {{toTurn}}.
